content.title: Christianity & Islam
content.subtitle: One conversation. Real differences.
content.description: Jesus, the oneness of God, the cross and Scripture. Read the Christian and Islamic texts together, then identify the question that needs an answer.

christian.text: The eternal Son became truly human: one person, fully God and fully man.

other.text: Qur’an 4:171 calls Jesus Messiah and messenger while rejecting divine sonship and the language of three.

christian.text: One divine being in three distinct persons: Father, Son and Holy Spirit.

other.text: Qur’an 112 affirms oneness and denies begetting; 4:171 rejects the language of three.

christian.text: Christ died for our sins, was buried and rose bodily. His saving work is essential to the gospel.

other.text: Qur’an 4:157 denies that Jesus' opponents killed or crucified him; 4:158 says God raised him.
